annotations.text:
A — Ink & Sand
Dark, hairline borders, one warm accent. Cards answer the three questions people open the app for: is it up, who is on, what address do I send.
Tradeoff: cards cost vertical space — about six servers per screen.

B — Workbench
Light and paper-toned, serif headings, one row per server, node stats as a header strip. Fifteen servers fit without scrolling.
Tradeoff: reads as a tool, not a game thing; less at-a-glance for a single server.

C — Operator
Console-forward: server rail on the left, live output filling the right. Monospace throughout, signal-green accent.
Tradeoff: opinionated and technical — great for one main server, heavier for a casual user.
